criteria.requirement: Extend BaseAdmonition directives with collapsible/expanded flags, rejecting expanded without collapsible. Preserve actual admonition/title/body nodes and existing localized specific-admonition transforms. HTML5 writer emits native details/summary, optional open, original inline formatting/escaping and correct nested pairs without JS; ordinary prompts remain on the original aside path. Other writers keep full visible text. Do not remove collapsed body, duplicate titles, mutate global visitor behavior or treat input raw HTML as trusted output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
